text:
There was an external transaction where Hero Entertainment sold its shares in Kuro to Tencent, making Tencent the majority shareholder with 51.4%, while Kuro’s developers retain 49%. Signs of Kuro’s separation from Hero were already evident, such as Kuro publishing WuWa directly and acquiring all PGR server rights. Hero's financial struggles, including selling shares in Game Science, further indicate this move was anticipated.

Kuro has reassured developers that Tencent has guaranteed their independent operations will remain unchanged, using Riot Games and Supercell as models. Despite Tencent’s majority stake, Chinese law grants Kuro significant control with its 49% share, allowing it to influence key decisions. In short, Kuro's operations stay stable, and they might finally get a better marketing budget.
